device.name: Antelope Discrete 4 Synergy Core
device.notes: vid, pid and bcdDevice all read from the unit's own Windows PnP instance id on a machine with it attached and enumerating: USB\VID_23E5&PID_A2BE carries FriendlyName "Discrete 4 Synergy Core", and HID\VID_23E5&PID_A2BE&REV_0401&MI_03 is the vendor-defined HID interface. The vid is no longer an assumption carried over from Orion. Serial deliberately not recorded.

transport.notes: report_size 320 is not assumed from Orion: this model's format defines the 0x83 meter report as a 16-byte header plus afx_meters of ubyte * 304, exactly 320. Interface 3 is from the PnP instance id (MI_03). Endpoints carried over from the family and NOT separately confirmed on this unit.
transport.evidence: Antelope's own machine-readable report format for this model, report_format_1.4.39 under the discrete4_hybrid slug. Read 2026-08-31 from a machine with the unit attached; the identical file, same SHA-256, is present on a second machine.

command.notes: SET_PARAM shape (magic/opcode/param_id_offset/channel_offset/value_offset) not yet captured for this device. Do not assume it matches Orion Studio III's 0x70/0x13/16/17/18 -- confirm from a fresh capture first, per README.md step 4 (check the outgoing URB_INTERRUPT out frame, not just the state-report diff).

state_report._comment: Offsets from bit-walking this model's declared 0x73 field list: 49 fields, 1824 bits, 228 bytes payload, 244-byte frame. The Discrete 4 Pro's 69-field layout and the Discrete 8 Pro's 66-field layout both total the same 1824, which checks the walk across three different devices.
state_report.notes: This model has FOUR preamp gains (byte * 4) against the Pro's byte * 7, and it has no volumes_and_mutes block at all, so there is no bus_block_offset here. The status bit order matches what this repository already found by observation elsewhere: phantom mask 0x10 shift 4, phase 0x40 shift 6. hpf at bit 5 and zero_cross at bit 7 are additions the format declares. NOT 'confirmed': no real 0x73 frame from this unit has been parsed with these offsets yet. The unit is attached and enumerating on the machine the format was read from, so this is checkable.
state_report.evidence: Antelope's own machine-readable report format for this model, report_format_1.4.39 under the discrete4_hybrid slug. Read 2026-08-31 from a machine with the unit attached; the identical file, same SHA-256, is present on a second machine.

provenance.method: vendor's own plaintext report format, read from the user's own disk
provenance.what_was_done: Opened a JSON file that Antelope's installer places on the machine of anyone who installs their software, at .AntelopeAudio/<slug>/panels/report_format_<version>. World-readable, not encrypted, not obfuscated, no licence header, no confidentiality marking, no credentials. Reading it is what the vendor's own control panel does at startup.
what_was_NOT_done: No decompilation or disassembly of any Antelope binary.
No decryption and no circumvention of any technical protection measure - there is none on this file.
No firmware modification, dump or patch.
Nothing behind a login, a licence server or an account.
No redistribution of the vendor's file: only facts derived from it appear here.
provenance.purpose: Interoperability: making hardware the owner has paid for controllable from their own operating system.
provenance.caveat: A record of method so the maintainer can judge it. Not legal advice.

channels.notes: The 0x73 preamps block is a struct of count 4, one status byte per preamp, and preamp_gains beside it is byte * 4. The two agree here, unlike on the Pro where the gain array is byte * 7 for four preamps.
